com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Enum MSTATUS

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<MSTATUS>
      • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.MSTATUS
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<MSTATUS>

    public enum MSTATUS
extends java.lang.Enum<MSTATUS>
    This class is used to return a bitmap of bits mostly relating to premarket, but a format bit flag is there as well. In order to check if the bit is set for ROSFORMT, here is an example : if((mstatus & MSTATUS.ROSFORMT.code()) == MSTATUS.ROSFORMT.code()) System.out.println( MSTATUS.ROSFORMT.toString()+ "is set ");
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    QUOTEFIELDS, QuoteManager

      • ROSFORMT

        public static final MSTATUS ROSFORMT
